Site name: UndefeatedXI
URL: https://undefeatedxi.com/

UndefeatedXI is the official soccer and football version of the viral 82-0.com game, built as a football history draft simulator where players draft an all-time XI and chase unbeaten records.

Important pages:
- Home and game: https://undefeatedxi.com/
- 82-0 soccer game landing page: https://undefeatedxi.com/82-0-soccer-game
- How to play: https://undefeatedxi.com/how-to-play
- Leaderboard: https://undefeatedxi.com/leaderboard
- Contact and feedback: https://undefeatedxi.com/contact

Target identity: UndefeatedXI is the official soccer and football version of 82-0.com, focused on football draft simulations, all-time XIs, perfect seasons, World Cup runs, leaderboards, and shareable results.
